name: harness-switch
description: A secure web control plane that switches API providers for Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, Pi and DeepSeek Harness by writing their native config files on SSH servers.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @seaveyon/harness-switch-web build && bun run --filter @seaveyon/harness-switch build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @seaveyon/harness-switch test && bun run --filter @seaveyon/harness-switch-web test
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && oxlint . && biome check .
